trigger_condition: Live OpenBao 2.6.2 and approved 2.6.4 have no current advisory applicability disposition.
guard_snippet: Inventory the affected authentication, Transit and OIDC features without credentials; document applicability and prepare a separately authorized supported, patched release.
potential_consequence: The deployed version is affected and the approved candidate still omits later fixes; exploit prerequisites were not established.
disposition: Confirmed new advisory-specific finding; version drift was already owned.

trigger_condition: Compensating controls claim every access/request is audited without runtime audit-write evidence.
guard_snippet: Qualify the claim to audited operations; disclose excluded health/seal-status paths and capture a correlated non-sensitive audited operation.
potential_consequence: The status smoke can pass without exercising the audit device, so the control is overstated.
disposition: Confirmed new documentation/control-evidence finding; declared-versus-loaded caveat exists elsewhere.

trigger_condition: The declared file audit destination has bounded storage with no documented rotation or pressure handling.
guard_snippet: Record an operations owner for rotation with SIGHUP, capacity/failure monitoring and audit availability verification; check the live arrangement before claiming rotation is absent.
potential_consequence: An unavailable sole audit destination can stop audited operations while unaudited status checks still succeed.
disposition: Confirmed documentation/evidence gap; live rotation absence and disk-full behavior were not tested.

trigger_condition: The expiry divergence says remeasurement requires reading a Kubernetes Secret.
guard_snippet: Inspect the public certificate at the intended endpoint and record identity and expiry, keeping private keys and Secret payloads unread.
potential_consequence: A safe expiry check is unnecessarily deferred and the historical rotation deadline stays unverified.
disposition: Confirmed correction; parent public-certificate inventory remeasured expiry without Secret access.

trigger_condition: Static seal material and all recovery shares share the Kubernetes platform trust boundary.
guard_snippet: Retain the disclosed limitation, plan an external seal trust source and separate recovery custody; describe compromise as combined Secret and storage access.
potential_consequence: Combined key-custody and storage compromise defeats at-rest protection; colocated shares supply no independent custody.
disposition: Existing accepted limitation reaffirmed; namespace read permissions alone do not imply PVC-content access.

trigger_condition: The application and cert-manager namespaces admit every pod to port 8200.
guard_snippet: Under a separately authorized operations change, narrow namespace-and-pod selectors to actual consumers and reconcile the record.
potential_consequence: Unrelated compromised workloads can reach the listener, increasing reliance on authentication and ACLs.
disposition: Existing accepted limitation reaffirmed; not a newly undocumented defect.

trigger_condition: Additional ingress policies and a NodePort broaden access beyond the four internal Services.
guard_snippet: Inventory Traefik routes, middleware and NodePort reachability, then justify or reconcile each source under its operations owner.
potential_consequence: Reviewing only the base policy or ClusterIP Services understates effective listener exposure.
disposition: Existing owned divergence, reconfirmed by live read-only probes; reachability from each source not exercised.

trigger_condition: Two bindings grant system:auth-delegator with no identified Kubernetes-auth consumer.
guard_snippet: Identify its consumer or revoke both chart and out-of-band bindings under operations authorization; preserve required discovery access.
potential_consequence: A compromised server identity retains unnecessary review privileges; changing the Helm value alone leaves the duplicate grant.
disposition: Existing owned divergence; does not imply permission to read Secret values.

trigger_condition: Servers, persistent data/audit volumes and snapshots share one node.
guard_snippet: Create an off-node/off-cluster snapshot copy and rehearse recovery before claiming node-loss recoverability.
potential_consequence: Loss of the storage failure domain can remove state and its only documented backup together.
disposition: Existing recovery gap; successful snapshot Jobs supply no off-cluster recovery proof.

trigger_condition: OnDelete and ConfigMap/template observations do not establish each server's loaded configuration.
guard_snippet: Keep declared-versus-effective caveats and reconcile admitted Pod fields and loaded security settings independently.
potential_consequence: A configuration correction can leave earlier settings running.
disposition: Existing owned divergence; parent measured admitted security/probe/mount fields but not loaded HCL.

trigger_condition: Ready replicas and HA status do not prove voting membership or exercised failover.
guard_snippet: Retain intended-voter qualifications until redacted membership evidence and a separately scoped failover exercise exist.
potential_consequence: Healthy replicas can be mistaken for demonstrated quorum and process failover.
disposition: Existing owned evidence gap; current runbook already qualifies it.

trigger_condition: Detected credential-shaped strings are interpolated into assertion failures.
guard_snippet: Assert that detection counts are zero using path and category only; verify failure output with synthetic canaries.
potential_consequence: A real credential can be copied from the rejected document into persistent CI logs.
disposition: Confirmed new guard defect; both string.Join messages and collection assertion rendering require removal.

trigger_condition: A reviewer completes one checkpoint while the other security gates remain open.
guard_snippet: Validate each checkpoint state, evaluator and date independently; require all gates only for parent completion.
potential_consequence: Valid partial review fails CI or encourages premature closure of other gates.
disposition: Confirmed new guard defect; overlaps VER-02 and is retained separately.

trigger_condition: Appointing a reviewer before signature makes the unsigned-record guard fail.
guard_snippet: Permit assigned-but-pending records without completion dates and add an in-memory control for that state.
potential_consequence: Recording a genuine appointment fails CI unless the record stays falsely unassigned or claims early closure.
evidence: Unsigned branch requires unassigned in evidence at1056 and every checkpoint owner at1080; controls at940-960 exercise wholly unassigned or wholly signed states only.

trigger_condition: Partial signatures or different checkpoint evaluators/dates cannot pass the global signed-state branch.
guard_snippet: Validate per-gate dispositions and signatures; test partial completion and mixed reviewers while the parent stays in-progress.
potential_consequence: CI pressures records to overstate all gates as complete under one signer and date.
disposition: Confirmed new guard defect; overlaps EDGE-02 and is retained separately.
consumer: ValidateCurrentSecurityRecords, called by real-record test at OpenBaoPlatformDocumentationTests.cs:901
evidence: One signed flag at1027 selects all three states at1063-1084; signed path requires one evaluator/date. Story lines267-273 explicitly require separate gates to preserve partial completion.
